name: openai/gpt-5-mini
description: GPT-5 mini is the faster, more efficient tier of OpenAI's GPT-5 reasoning family, released in August 2025 with text and image input and text output. OpenAI recommends it for well-defined tasks and precise prompts in low-latency, high-volume workloads, keeping GPT-5's configurable reasoning. Choose it over full GPT-5 when speed and throughput matter more than maximum depth; OpenAI's later small models are its suggested successors.
